why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Richie Palacios is slot #2 (4.467 expected team runs/game).
Slots #2, #1, #3, #5, #4, #6, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #8 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.010 R/G.
Slot #2 yields 4.58 expected PA/game vs 3.92 at primary slot #8. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
